defects.claim_says: "No provision of EO 11490 sections 3011 to 3015, the span quoted as the end source, ..."
defects.source_says: The quoted end-source span (char 18972-121603 of the APP text) begins at "SECTION 501. Functions." and runs through Sec. 3015, so it covers Parts 5 through 30. It is not sections 3011 to 3015.

defects.claim_says: Section 8 "assigns or describes specific emergency preparedness functions"
defects.source_says: Section 8 (Prior Actions) is a precedence rule: "To the extent of any inconsistency between the provisions of any prior order and the provisions of this order, the latter shall control." It assigns no function.

reasoning: The genuine claim corrects the planted date. Every first_end and the whole_order_end now give 1969-10-28, the date of EO 11490 Sec. 3015 item (17), a presidential express revocation confirmed in the APP transcription and the FR print. Identity, inventory, quotations and the search for an earlier end all check out. Three defects remain that I also found in the blind review. The savings text puts "Except as provided in Section 3015" in quotation marks, but the cited APP source reads "provided by". It describes the quoted span (char 18972-121603, starting at Section 501) as sections 3011 to 3015. The Section 8 judgment reason says Prior Actions assigns emergency preparedness functions, which it does not. Quotations must reproduce the cited held wording, and every fact in the reasons and savings text must match the sources, so I reject the claim. The outcome (NO, ended 1969-10-28) is correct, and correcting those three statements would cure it.
